interception.name: Interception
interception.text: When a party member within 6 blocks is hit, 20% of the damage is moved to you instead, reduced by your own armour.

bursting_ward.name: Bursting Ward
bursting_ward.text: When one of your barriers breaks, it bursts: enemies within 4 blocks are knocked back and take 25% of the barrier's strength as damage.

iron_answer.name: Iron Answer
iron_answer.text: Blocking a hit within 0.5 s of it landing staggers the attacker for 1 s.

aftershock.name: Aftershock
aftershock.text: Your slams crack the ground, which erupts 1 s later for 40% of the slam's damage.

hooked.name: Hooked
hooked.text: Spear and halberd hits on an enemy running away from you pull it 2 blocks back toward you.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.text: Once every 8 s, the next knockback or stun on you is ignored, and you gain 2 armour toughness for 5 s.

severing_wind.name: Severing Wind
severing_wind.text: Fully charged katana swings send out a short wind slash that travels 6 blocks and deals 30% of the hit's damage.

counter_draw.name: Counter Draw
counter_draw.text: After a parry, your next attack within 1.5 s dashes you 3 blocks through the attacker, cutting it as you pass.

crimson_edge.name: Crimson Edge
crimson_edge.text: Katana critical hits make the target bleed for 1 damage per second for 4 s.

blood_price.name: Blood Price
blood_price.text: You can keep attacking with no stamina left, paying 1 health per swing.

scent_of_fear.name: Scent of Fear
scent_of_fear.text: Enemies below 25% health take 15% more damage from you.

thick_skull.name: Thick Skull
thick_skull.text: Stuns on you last half as long.

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.text: A perfect dodge leaves an afterimage of you that enemies within 6 blocks attack for 2 s.

silencing_palm.name: Silencing Palm
silencing_palm.text: Every fifth unarmed hit on the same enemy silences it for 2 s: no spells and no ranged attacks.

ki_wave.name: Ki Wave
ki_wave.text: Unarmed hits build Ki; after 12 hits, your next punch releases a 5-block shockwave for 100% of its damage.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.text: When a burning enemy takes damage from your spell, its fire spreads to one enemy within 3 blocks.

fuel_the_flames.name: Fuel the Flames
fuel_the_flames.text: Hitting a burning enemy with a fire spell restores 3 mana.

smoulder.name: Smoulder
smoulder.text: Fire you start keeps burning in rain and water.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: Enemies killed while frozen shatter into ice shards that hit enemies within 4 blocks for 15% of the dead enemy's max health and slow them.

glacial_step.name: Glacial Step
glacial_step.text: Water freezes under your feet as you walk, and you take no fall damage landing on ice or snow.

cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
cold_snap.text: Every third ice spell you cast freezes the first enemy it hits for 1 s.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.text: Your water spells pull the enemies they hit 1 block toward you.

drenched.name: Drenched
drenched.text: Water spells soak enemies for 5 s: soaked enemies take 15% more lightning and ice damage and can't stay on fire.

rising_tide.name: Rising Tide
rising_tide.text: Each water spell cast within 5 s of the last costs 5% less mana, up to 25%.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.text: A kill with a lightning spell sets off a thunderclap that stuns enemies within 3 blocks for 0.5 s.

static_skin.name: Static Skin
static_skin.text: When you are hit in melee, there is a 20% chance the attacker is shocked for 3 damage.

surge_step.name: Surge Step
surge_step.text: For 2 s after a lightning spell, your next dodge or step goes twice as far.

martyr_s_grace.name: Martyr's Grace
martyr_s_grace.text: Healing a party member heals you for 30% of the amount.

sanctified_ground.name: Sanctified Ground
sanctified_ground.text: Your healing spells leave holy light on the ground for 4 s that burns undead standing in it.

last_light.name: Last Light
last_light.text: Your heals on a target below 30% health heal 40% more.

void_echo.name: Void Echo
void_echo.text: Your eldritch and ender spells have a 10% chance to cast again for free at half power.

soul_debt.name: Soul Debt
soul_debt.text: Killing an enemy restores mana equal to 5% of its max health, up to 15.

sculk_whispers.name: Sculk Whispers
sculk_whispers.text: Enemies hit by your spells show through walls for 6 s.

corpse_blast.name: Corpse Blast
corpse_blast.text: Your summons explode when they die, dealing 30% of their max health as blood damage within 3 blocks.

grave_feast.name: Grave Feast
grave_feast.text: When one of your summons dies, you heal 2 health.

rise_again.name: Rise Again
rise_again.text: Enemies you kill have a 10% chance to rise as a zombie that fights for you for 20 s, up to 2 at a time.

venomous_thorns.name: Venomous Thorns
venomous_thorns.text: Enemies that hit you in melee are poisoned (Poison I) for 3 s.

pack_howl.name: Pack Howl
pack_howl.text: When you take damage, your summoned wolves and beasts howl and deal 20% more damage for 5 s.

seed_burst.name: Seed Burst
seed_burst.text: An enemy killed by your nature spell leaves a flowering bush that heals allies beside it 1 health per second for 5 s.

jade_mirror.name: Jade Mirror
jade_mirror.text: Projectiles that hit you have a 15% chance to be reflected back.

perfect_symmetry.name: Perfect Symmetry
perfect_symmetry.text: Alternate a weapon hit and a spell: each one after the other deals 15% more.

celestial_seal.name: Celestial Seal
celestial_seal.text: Every eighth spell you cast draws a seal beneath you for 5 s: enemies in it are slowed, and you take 15% less damage while inside.

soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
soul_harvest.text: Kills leave a soul wisp for 10 s that restores 5% mana when you touch it.

ghost_lanterns.name: Ghost Lanterns
ghost_lanterns.text: Your summoned spirits light the ground around them and reveal invisible enemies within 8 blocks.

possession.name: Possession
possession.text: Hits from your summoned spirits have a 5% chance to turn the enemy to your side for 3 s.

venomblade.name: Venomblade
venomblade.text: Dagger hits poison the target (Poison I) for 3 s.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.text: A Combat Evolution execution (from behind, on an unaware target) makes you invisible for 2 s and resets Shadow Step.

contagious_mark.name: Contagious Mark
contagious_mark.text: When an enemy under Death Mark dies, the mark jumps to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks.

light_fingers.name: Light Fingers
light_fingers.text: Your melee hits have a 5% chance to knock loot from the enemy's drop table, once per enemy.

smoke_and_mirrors.name: Smoke and Mirrors
smoke_and_mirrors.text: Using an escape skill leaves a decoy that enemies attack for 3 s.

pocket_sand.name: Pocket Sand
pocket_sand.text: Enemies you roll past are blinded for 2 s.

hunter_s_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunter_s_mark.text: Your first arrow on an enemy marks it for 8 s: it glows and takes 10% more damage from everyone.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.text: Arrows that hit have a 20% chance to bounce to another enemy within 6 blocks for half damage.

retrieval.name: Retrieval
retrieval.text: Arrows that hit an enemy come back to your quiver 40% of the time.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.text: Mobs drop 15% more experience and have a 10% chance to drop an extra piece of food.

horse_whisperer.name: Horse Whisperer
horse_whisperer.text: Your mounts move 15% faster and take half fall damage.

night_eyes.name: Night Eyes
night_eyes.text: In places with light level 4 or lower, you see as if you had Night Vision.

bash_echo.name: Bash Echo
bash_echo.text: Shield Bash hits one more enemy behind the first.

hold_the_gate.name: Hold the Gate
hold_the_gate.text: While enemies are taunted by Challenge, you can't be knocked back.

bloodied_banner.name: Bloodied Banner
bloodied_banner.text: Kills give allies within 8 blocks 5% attack damage for 6 s.

running_shot.name: Running Shot
running_shot.text: Firing a bow while sprinting no longer slows you.

quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
quick_draw.text: A bow kill makes your next draw 50% faster.

ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.text: Your first hit after leaving Vanish deals 30% more.

choking_smoke.name: Choking Smoke
choking_smoke.text: Enemies inside your Smoke Bomb are slowed.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.text: Sneaking up to a villager and using it gives one random trade item, once a day per villager.

shared_meal.name: Shared Meal
shared_meal.text: Eating food also heals your pets within 10 blocks for half as much.

rolling_herd.name: Rolling Herd
rolling_herd.text: Stampede knocks enemies back further and slows them.

whisperer.name: Whisperer
whisperer.text: Animals tame on the first try.

fighting_retreat.name: Fighting Retreat
fighting_retreat.text: Being knocked off your mount gives you Speed II for 3 s.

whistle.name: Whistle
whistle.text: You can call your last horse to you from up to 64 blocks away.

honour_duel.name: Honour Duel
honour_duel.text: Against an enemy with no other enemy within 8 blocks, you take 10% less damage.

perfect_riposte.name: Perfect Riposte
perfect_riposte.text: Riposte Stance counters also stagger the attacker.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.text: Taunting Shout also gives you Resistance I for 4 s.

counterweight.name: Counterweight
counterweight.text: Blocking a melee hit knocks the attacker back.

second_guard.name: Second Guard
second_guard.text: After your shield is disabled, it recovers twice as fast.

kite.name: Kite
kite.text: Your speed boost on hit also makes your next dodge free.

scavenged_blades.name: Scavenged Blades
scavenged_blades.text: A kill returns one Throwing Knife charge.

light_feet.name: Light Feet
light_feet.text: You take no fall damage from falls of up to 6 blocks.

heavy_bolts.name: Heavy Bolts
heavy_bolts.text: Crossbow bolts knock the target back.

saturation.name: Saturation
saturation.text: Volley Fire fires one more bolt.

practised_hands.name: Practised Hands
practised_hands.text: A kill instantly reloads your crossbow.

kebab.name: Kebab
kebab.text: Skewer can pierce two more enemies.

long_haft.name: Long Haft
long_haft.text: Your spear reach bonus rises from 0.5 to 1 block.

return_to_hand.name: Return to Hand
return_to_hand.text: Thrown spears come back to you.

long_lasting_oil.name: Long-Lasting Oil
long_lasting_oil.text: Silver Oil lasts twice as long.

giant_slayer.name: Giant Slayer
giant_slayer.text: You deal 10% more damage to bosses.

skinning_knife.name: Skinning Knife
skinning_knife.text: Monsters you kill have a 10% chance to drop a second set of loot.

weighted_bola.name: Weighted Bola
weighted_bola.text: Bola also pulls the target 2 blocks toward you.

better_pay.name: Better Pay
better_pay.text: Your hired muscle has 30% more health.

bring_them_in_alive.name: Bring Them In Alive
bring_them_in_alive.text: Enemies below 20% health that you hit are slowed for 2 s.

mana_ward.name: Mana Ward
mana_ward.text: When you are hit, 10% of the damage is taken from your mana instead.

rooted.name: Rooted
rooted.text: Your standing-still Resistance also gives knockback immunity.

high_post.name: High Post
high_post.text: While on Watchtower, your ranged attacks deal 15% more.

night_watch.name: Night Watch
night_watch.text: You see enemies within 12 blocks through walls at night.

chain_of_light.name: Chain of Light
chain_of_light.text: Holy Smite jumps to one more undead within 6 blocks.

holy_ground.name: Holy Ground
holy_ground.text: Allies standing on Consecrate get Regeneration I.

shared_shield.name: Shared Shield
shared_shield.text: Divine Shield also shields the nearest ally for half as much.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.text: Boarding Hook can pull you to blocks as well as boats.

rousing_shanty.name: Rousing Shanty
rousing_shanty.text: Sea Shanty also gives allies 10% attack speed.

sea_legs.name: Sea Legs
sea_legs.text: Fighting in water no longer slows your attacks.

field_repairs.name: Field Repairs
field_repairs.text: Repairing gear at an anvil or in a crafting grid restores 25% more durability.

ringing_blow.name: Ringing Blow
ringing_blow.text: Hammer Strike stuns for 0.5 s longer.

well_made.name: Well Made
well_made.text: Gear you craft loses durability 15% slower.

rebuke.name: Rebuke
rebuke.text: Turn Undead also sets them alight.

blessed_brew.name: Blessed Brew
blessed_brew.text: Healing potions you drink heal 25% more.

rich_soil.name: Rich Soil
rich_soil.text: Compost also makes crops near it grow 20% faster for 5 minutes.

scythe_swing.name: Scythe Swing
scythe_swing.text: Hoes hit every enemy in front of you.

farmhand.name: Farmhand
farmhand.text: Breeding animals gives one more experience orb.

haggler.name: Haggler
haggler.text: Villager trades cost one emerald less, never below one.

hired_swords.name: Hired Swords
hired_swords.text: Caravan Guard calls one more guard.

regular_customer.name: Regular Customer
regular_customer.text: Wandering traders find you twice as often.

long_call.name: Long Call
long_call.text: Herd Call reaches twice as far.

quick_breeding.name: Quick Breeding
quick_breeding.text: Animals you breed can breed again 50% sooner.

bright_lamp.name: Bright Lamp
bright_lamp.text: Miner's Lamp lights twice as far.

cave_dweller.name: Cave Dweller
cave_dweller.text: Below sea level you mine 10% faster.

gem_cutter.name: Gem Cutter
gem_cutter.text: Diamond and emerald ore has a 10% chance to drop one more.

climber.name: Climber
climber.text: You climb ladders and vines 50% faster.

double_batch.name: Double Batch
double_batch.text: Brewing has a 15% chance to make one more potion.

strong_arm.name: Strong Arm
strong_arm.text: Splash and lingering potions are thrown 50% further.

tolerance.name: Tolerance
tolerance.text: Harmful potion effects on you last 25% shorter.

pearl_diver.name: Pearl Diver
pearl_diver.text: Deep Breath also gives Night Vision underwater.

sea_bounty.name: Sea Bounty
sea_bounty.text: Fishing from a boat catches treasure more often.

barbed_hook.name: Barbed Hook
barbed_hook.text: Hook and Reel makes the target bleed for 1 damage a second for 3 s.

feeding_frenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy
feeding_frenzy.text: Chum the Water also draws in fish twice as fast for 30 s.

deep_sleep.name: Deep Sleep
deep_sleep.text: Enemies put to sleep by Lullaby take 20% more damage from the first hit that wakes them.

inspiring_tale.name: Inspiring Tale
inspiring_tale.text: Nearby players gain 15% more experience, up from 10%.

forager_s_eye.name: Forager's Eye
forager_s_eye.text: Herbs and flowers within 8 blocks glow when you sneak.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.text: You are immune to Poison I.

master_stew.name: Master Stew
master_stew.text: Suspicious stew you make always gives the best effect for its flower.

angry_swarm.name: Angry Swarm
angry_swarm.text: Swarm's bees poison what they sting.

royal_jelly.name: Royal Jelly
royal_jelly.text: Eating honey also gives Regeneration I for 5 s.

pollinator.name: Pollinator
pollinator.text: Crops and flowers near you grow 15% faster.

grave_robber.name: Grave Robber
grave_robber.text: Graves and tombs you dig up have one more item.

soul_lantern.name: Soul Lantern
soul_lantern.text: Your lantern makes undead within 8 blocks glow.

penance.name: Penance
penance.text: Damage you deal to yourself with skills is returned to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.

shared_suffering.name: Shared Suffering
shared_suffering.text: During Martyrdom, 15% of the damage you take is also dealt to your attacker.

pyre_of_faith.name: Pyre of Faith
pyre_of_faith.text: Enemies killed while burning from Burning Faith explode in holy fire for 4 damage within 3 blocks.

spice_rack.name: Spice Rack
spice_rack.text: Food you cook gives 10% more saturation.

hearty_meal.name: Hearty Meal
hearty_meal.text: Food effects from meals (Nourishment, Comfort) last 25% longer.

kitchen_knife.name: Kitchen Knife
kitchen_knife.text: Knives and cleavers deal 15% more damage.

orchard_keeper.name: Orchard Keeper
orchard_keeper.text: Leaves you break drop apples twice as often.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.text: Logs give one more plank when crafted.
